panel.speaker: Bran Tolley
panel.say: Name, and what you carry. Nothing? Then you will fit in. Put your name in the task master's ledger and I will find you a blade.

tracker.title: A Name in the Ledger
tracker.step: Speak with the task master and accept a task

offer.speaker: Odalys Venn
offer.say: Tolley sent you. Good. He counts people and I look at them, and you will do. Three wardlights on three roads are guttering, and I am one woman with one pair of knees. I need hands.

brief.speaker: Odalys Venn
brief.say: A wardlight burns ash to keep ash away, the way you bleed a fever. The town lamp is nearly out of it. Burn three logs at any forge and bring me what is left. Three measures of ashes. Do not sift them.
options: 1Three measures of ashes. I will bring them.
